summary: Southern California Gas Company, an indirect Sempra subsidiary, closed a registered public offering of $500 million 5.500% First Mortgage Bonds, Series GGG, due September 1, 2036, on August 21, 2026. Net proceeds equal 98.755% of principal before roughly $1.1 million of estimated expenses. Interest accrues from August 21, 2026, payable semiannually each March 1 and September 1 starting March 1, 2027; the bonds are optionally redeemable pre-maturity. This is routine debt financing under an existing Form S-3 shelf, not a special situation; watch only for leverage and rate-refinancing effects on SoCalGas credit metrics.
